title: Cocktail 2 Drops Its First Songs — and NRIs Who Grew Up on the Original Need to Pay Attention
excerpt: Shahid Kapoor, Kriti Sanon, and Rashmika Mandanna replace the iconic Saif-Deepika-Diana trio. The trailer arrives May 29.
body:
If you were an NRI in your twenties when the original *Cocktail* released in 2012, you remember exactly where you were. The Deepika Padukone party-girl-to-heartbreak arc. The London backdrop that felt like your life. Yo Yo Honey Singh's "Angreji Beat" blasting at every desi house party from Brampton to Bay Area for the next three years. That film wasn't just a movie for the diaspora — it was a cultural timestamp.

Now, fourteen years later, *Cocktail 2* is officially on its way. And the cast switch-up alone is enough to start an argument in every NRI WhatsApp group.

## The New Trio

**Shahid Kapoor** steps in for Saif Ali Khan. **Kriti Sanon** takes over what was Deepika Padukone's career-defining role. **Rashmika Mandanna** replaces Diana Penty. The director's chair goes to **Homi Adajania** (who directed *Finding Fanny* and *Cocktail* the original), with **Luv Ranjan** co-writing the script alongside Tarun Jain.

The film is billed as a "spiritual sequel" — same world, same emotional DNA, but new characters and a new setting. Reports suggest the story moves from London to **Sicily**, trading the grey British skies of the original for Mediterranean sun. For a franchise built on location-as-character, the shift could work — or it could lose the specific expat energy that made the first one hit so hard for audiences abroad.

## The Songs Are Already Here

At a Mumbai event on May 17, the *Cocktail 2* team debuted two tracks to media: **'Mashooka'** (described as a foot-tapping party number) and **'Tujhko'** (a soulful ballad). Music is by **Pritam Chakraborty**, who scored the original's iconic soundtrack including "Tumhi Ho Bandhu" and "Daaru Desi."

https://www.instagram.com/p/DYjauP9gBiM/

Shahid called the filming experience genuinely fun. "Mashooka has a vibe that pulls you in instantly," he said. "Kriti and I genuinely had such a blast shooting this one because it doesn't take itself too seriously." Kriti added that the track has "a very fresh sound and energy."

The *Tujhko* video ends with a title card confirming the **trailer drops May 29**. The film releases in cinemas on **June 19, 2026**.

## Why NRIs Should Be Watching

The original *Cocktail* earned roughly 150 crore worldwide — with a disproportionate chunk coming from overseas markets. It worked because it understood a specific feeling: being young, Indian, and living somewhere that isn't India. The party scenes felt like your friends. The emotional stakes felt like your cousin's drama. The music felt like your Saturday night.

Whether *Cocktail 2* can replicate that emotional resonance with a Sicily setting and an entirely new cast is the central gamble. But Shahid Kapoor has been on a career upswing since *Deva* and *Ashwatthama*, Kriti Sanon proved her range with the *Mimi* franchise, and Rashmika Mandanna brings a pan-India appeal that the original's cast didn't have. The Maddock Films and Luv Films production house pairing also signals serious budget and marketing muscle.

## Box Office Expectations

Analysts project *Cocktail 2* could rank among Shahid Kapoor's five highest-grossing opening weekends. The June 19 release date puts it in a relatively clear window — no major Bollywood competition in the immediate vicinity.

For NRIs, the key question is whether the film will get wide international distribution. Given Maddock Films' track record (they're behind the *Stree*-*Munjya* horror universe), expect solid screen counts across North America, the UK, Australia, and the Middle East.

The trailer on May 29 should answer the biggest question: does this feel like a real sequel to a film that mattered to millions, or just a nostalgia play with a famous name? Mark your calendars.
